prediction_point: initial reservation creation (historical-snapshot caveat in report)

excluded_features.ReservationStatusDate: Date of a later status update, including cancellation.

excluded_features.BookingChanges: Cumulative amendments after the reservation was created.
excluded_features.DaysInWaitingList: Elapsed waiting time is not known at initial booking.
